source: Assistant-generated European Portuguese category supplement based on a local SQLite vocabulary audit
scope: Review all 104 existing categories; add common A1/A2 European Portuguese words and missing category links. This is a curated extension, not an exhaustive vocabulary standard.
provenance: Generated by the assistant. Book-section supplements are editorial teaching suggestions and are not attributed to the textbook or the Carla articles.
word_policy: Only lowercase NFC-normalized individual words. Keep lexical compounds with hyphens and meaningful gender forms. No phrases or new categories.

enrichment.translations: Assistant English and Ukrainian translations for new words; existing translations retained exactly. No independent human review.
enrichment.CEFR: Assistant estimates for new words; existing values retained. Starting-path membership is distinct from word CEFR level.

hamster.note: Loanword spelling and animal sense verified; hámster is also listed.

bica.note: Espresso sense verified; the batch selects the café context.

galão.note: Portuguese coffee-with-milk sense verified; the batch selects the café context.

pera.note: Current orthography and fruit sense verified.

contextual_meaning_gaps.action: Not linked to the money unit: existing translation covers a school grade. Additional sense needs a separate translation update.
Not linked to the farming unit as a verb: existing translation is spoon. Apanhar is used instead.

enrichment.preservation: Importer adds words and memberships only. Existing IDs, translations, levels, mastery and history are preserved.
